'''Nuhel Dromand''' is [[Warder]] to [[Myrelle Berengari]], who saved him after the [[Aes Sedai]] to whom he was [[Bonding|bonded]] died. Rumor has it that he may be married to Myrelle.

== Appearance ==
He is an [[Illianer]], with dark hair to his shoulders and the typical Illian beard leaving his upper lip bare. He is tall, dark, and bulky. He had a thick Illianer accent. His flowing Warder movement seemed odd on him. {{ref|{{twotc}}, Nuhel Dromand}}

== Activities ==
He is present when [[Egwene al'Vere]] is dressing down Myrelle for hiding [[Lan Mandragoran]] in [[Salidar]]. He is on edge watching Lan practice with the sword and picking up Myrelle's somber mood.

He is guarding Myrelle's tent when [[Siuan Sanche]] arrives with the news that Egwene is still alive inside the [[White Tower]].
